title: How to Get a 300 Combo in Project P.I.T.T. — x300 Achievement Guide
h1: How to Get a 300 Combo in Project P.I.T.T. — x300 Achievement Guide
quickAnswer: Aim for MEGA! (x300) by building a short, visible, recoverable lane and maintaining a reliable production handoff; test one source → one route → one receiver, add tested automation, and attempt this before entering final/ending progression.
description:
x300 / 300 combo answer
MEGA! is x300 and is the target for the 300 Combo achievement; MORE! is x100 and EXTRA! is x200. The core problem to solve is not launching a big burst but keeping a reliable production handoff long enough to hit MEGA!.

reliable method
Use a short, visible, recoverable lane pattern that you can watch and fix quickly. Prioritize a single tested source, a single tested route, and a single tested receiver so items transfer predictably. Practice hitting MORE! and EXTRA! as stepping stones before pushing for MEGA!.

what resets or breaks the combo
Anything that stops the continuous, observable handoff can reset the combo: jams, misalignment, containment failures, or a receiver dropping items out of sequence. Unreliable multi-source routes are a common cause of interruption.

common failure reasons
- Poorly observed lanes that hide jams or misfeeds.
- Multiple untested sources or receivers creating race conditions.
- Trying an unproven long burst instead of stabilizing a short recoverable lane.

how automation helps
Automation can assist once you have one source, one route, and one receiver tested. Existing automation guidance covers panels, fans, magnets, pistons, launchers, alignment, containment, and jam recovery — use those tested tools to hold the lane and recover quickly. See [Automation]({{page:automation}}) for lane setup details and tested components.

how the Shift Scheduler can help
The Shift Scheduler can help with timed or batch behavior when it is connected and tested correctly; use it to coordinate repeatable timing windows or batch launches after you have validated the single-source route. Refer to [the Shift Scheduler Guide]({{page:shift-scheduler}}) for setup and testing tips.

safest progression timing
If you have not completed x300, it is safer to prioritize the attempt before entering final/ending progression. This is a timing recommendation based on player reports, not a claim that the achievement becomes impossible afterward. For completion timing guidance see [the Achievements Guide]({{page:achievements}}).

FAQ
Q: Should I automate immediately?
A: Only after you have tested the one source → one route → one receiver flow manually; automation is helpful but must be validated to avoid hidden failures.

Q: Are there required machines or a combo timer?
A: No. Do not rely on any single universal layout or claimed exact combo timer — focus on a reliable, short, recoverable lane and validated automation.

Q: Will attempting this after ending progression break the achievement?
A: The community recommends attempting x300 before final/ending progression if you haven’t done it yet; this is precautionary, not a statement that it becomes impossible later.
